essence: A datamosh / digital-signal glitch. Over the source it stamps horizontal bands of 'damaged' corrupted blocks (grey noise + block artifacts), fired in bursts over time, with an optional horizontal pixel shift. The canonical 故障 / broken-signal look — grey blocky bands slicing across the image. Source shows through untouched between bands.
manifests_as: horizontal grey/noisy corrupted BANDS across the frame (not a full-frame wash) — verified by probe

key_levers.name: Glitch Intensity
key_levers.effect: MASTER dial — amount/coverage of glitch bands. 0 = clean (off), ~30-50 = occasional band, ~90 = heavy corruption. Probe-confirmed.

key_levers.name: Block Size
key_levers.effect: scale of the corrupted blocks. 1 = thin fine datamosh stripes; 7 = large chunky square blocks. Probe-confirmed 1↔7.

key_levers.name: Block Damage Intensity
key_levers.effect: how corrupted/grey-noisy the damaged blocks read (low = source-tinted, high = flat grey static).

key_levers.name: Glitch Interval
key_levers.effect: time between glitch bursts. LOW ≈ near-constant glitching, HIGH = rare flashes. (Set low to make the glitch visible in a still.)

key_levers.name: Shift Group Intensity
key_levers.effect: horizontal pixel-shift / displacement of the glitched bands (subtle at a static frame).

key_levers.name: Pattern Amount
key_levers.effect: amount of digital-noise pattern inside the damaged blocks.

enums_to_verify.Block Blend Mode (1-7): how damaged blocks composite over source — likely Normal/Add/Screen/Lighten/… (probe if a specific blend is needed)

config_recipes.subtle rhythm-hit glitch: Glitch Intensity 30-50, Block Size 2-3, Interval 15-30, Duration 20-40 — brief flashes on the beat
config_recipes.heavy constant datamosh: Glitch Intensity 80-100, Block Size 5-7, Block Damage 80-100, Interval 1-3, Duration 90-100
config_recipes.fine-stripe corruption: Block Size 1-2, Glitch Intensity 60-80 — thin scanline-ish datamosh
config_recipes.artist's KillKiss usage (observed): on a duplicated lyric layer with Fill, Camera-Shake OFF — Glitch Duration 95; used as a per-lyric stutter accent, paired with a clean twin (Ramp+Textures) that carries the base look

reasoning_hooks.make it subtler: lower Glitch Intensity (→30-40) and/or raise Interval (rarer bursts)
reasoning_hooks.bigger chunkier glitch: raise Block Size (→6-7) + Block Damage Intensity
reasoning_hooks.make it flicker occasionally not constan: raise Glitch Interval, lower Glitch Duration
reasoning_hooks.not showing in a still frame: the glitch is interval-triggered — set Interval low / Duration high, or it's simply between bursts at that time

grounding: introspect card (95 params, full SEMANTIC names + ranges + enum spans — cards/BCC_Cross_Glitch.json) + visual probe (introspect/frames/bcc_*: Intensity=band amount, Block Size 1=stripes/7=blocks) + model prior on BCC Cross Glitch. Confidence: high on the levers, medium on the untested enums.
_method: introspect + focused probe + synth (the essence-card pipeline)
